name: Curvature Field Line Tracing for Strokes
definition: Generating hatching strokes by tracing paths from seed points along maximal curvature directions in object space, using RK4(3) integration with adaptive step size.
summary: Curvature Field Line Tracing for Strokes generates hatching by tracing paths along maximal curvature directions rather than velocity vectors, using adaptive step sizes and deviation thresholds to ensure visual coherence.
